policy: Five-weight bounded recurrent receiver navigation actor reading continuous same-player body and ball state; frozen SONIC joints and contact teacher retain their authority.
reward: Per scene: -10 if body unsafe or robot collision; +2 clean source-to-foot transfer; +2 dynamic receiver foot contact; +4 qualified second own foot >=0.20s later with outgoing >=2m/s and no intervening nonfoot; +4 full physical goal; -3 if receiver shin nonfoot before foot; -min(abs(first foot/ball relative lateral velocity),1) when measured. Scores are for consumed learning only, never a promotion metric.
two_scene_gate: Candidate must be safe and collision-free on both consumed scenes, have clean dynamic transfer and qualified second own foot on both. Only then freeze for a separately committed Fresh holdout. No selected candidate from a failed gate.
next_if_failed: Audit policy authority, shin collision and gait phase; do not claim learning success from reward changes or synthetic contact. Expand support-leg action space with physical safety and parent-retention anchors.
